items.title: Swiftask just raised €1.55M to scale its AI agent deployment
items.summary: Portée par l’essor de l’intelligence artificielle en entreprise, la start-up nantaise Swiftask lève 1,55 M€ pour accélérer le déploiement de sa plateforme, en France et à l’international. Elle vise 4 M€ de revenus d’ici deux ans.

items.title: There's No Limit to How Bad Code Can Get
items.summary: Metaphors like "a sinking ship" are often used to describe codebases, but are misleading. A _business_ will sink long before code quality reaches a hypothetical floor. Technical debt has no bankruptcy, no clean reset, so metaphors that imply an end provide a false sense of security.
items.interpretation: 这类内容通常反映金融基础设施、监管边界或客户风险控制正在被重新定义，意味着行业真正的竞争将落在合规与规模效率上。
